nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some of the commonly used statistical methods in assessing groundwater vulnerability?
nodes.answer: Commonly used statistical methods in assessing groundwater vulnerability include Multiple Linear Regression (MLR), Logistic Regression (LR), Weights Of Evidence (WOE), Bayesian Belief Networks (BBNs), and analysis of variance (ANOVA).

nodes.question: What model was used to map groundwater nitrate contaminant risk in Ethiopia?
nodes.answer: The modified DRASTIC model was used to map groundwater nitrate contaminant risk in Ethiopia.
